method: Hand-read by the PIL agent from each document's text layer (npm run sync-hs-profiles -- --dump <id>), fetched politely by the pipeline. Five documents come from pilot schools whose profiles the pipeline could fetch (the only five distinct ones; Covenant appears twice in PSS); seven come from other high schools in the same three metros, found by hand search, because only five distinct pilot profiles were fetchable (the rest are behind robots.txt rules or not published). Brief asked for 15; 12 fetchable current profiles were found (one an HTML page). matriculation lists were transcribed with a small parser over the dumped lines and checked against the text by eye. Field rules: gpa_scale.kind is the base scale the school states (a 4.0 base with Honors/AP points added is unweighted-4 with weighted = true); class_size is the class the profile describes; scores only when a middle 50% is printed; matriculation only for enrollment lists, never acceptance lists.

schools.name: Lakehill Preparatory School
schools.notes: Official GPA unweighted on a 4.0 scale (A+ = 4.0); a weighted GPA (+1 for AP) is on the transcript for colleges, so weighted = true. Tests are averages only. The college list is acceptances, not enrollment.

schools.name: The Covenant School
schools.notes: Base scale tops at A+ = 4.50, Advanced +.25, AP +.5. "Due to small class size, we do not publish GPA distributions." AP courses from the course offerings (the AP testing line also names European History, Physics 1, Pre-Calculus exams). Matriculation: a representative list of institutions attended (undergraduate and graduate), no counts or years. The same document serves PSS duplicate A2400183.

schools.name: Brentwood School
schools.notes: Class of 2027 profile. Unweighted GPA; weighted GPA reported to colleges on the transcript. Distribution percentages interleave with the grading table in the layout. Tests are means only. Matriculation list has no counts.

schools.name: Palos Verdes High
schools.notes: No senior class size printed (the distribution counts total 339; not inferred). Weighted GPA = unweighted 4.0 plus 0.2 per weighted course; the distribution is of weighted GPAs (counts → shares). AP Seminar is listed as not offered in 2025-26 and left out. SAT is a 50th percentile, ACT means: no middle 50%.

schools.name: Beverly Hills High
schools.notes: 4-point scale with an extra point for Honors/AP ("an A in an Honors or AP course is worth 5 points"). The GPA table is percentile cut-offs (Top 5%, Top 10%...), not a distribution. Tests are means only. "Spanish Lanuage" is the profile's own spelling.

schools.name: Cistercian Preparatory School
